intro: Brutal Gauntlets is the culmination of an artisan's craft for seasoned Horde warriors. After gathering rare components across distant lands, the craftsman Ula'elek fashions a formidable pair of handguards designed to bring honor to both the maker and the bearer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. These gauntlets are my best work. Take them. In wearing them, you bring honor to me and my ancestors.
